value.rationale: The finite-number excitation scale is naturally obtained by balancing N independent quadratic-in-time Rabi flip probabilities with rapid global Poisson resetting; the sharp gamma proportional sqrt(N) threshold separates vanishing and diverging counts. At this boundary synchronized and independent interventions having identical one-spin marginals yield sharply different universal count distributions and upper-tail exponents. This provides a meaningful mesoscopic manifestation of clock-induced collective burstiness not determined by the fixed-rate average alone.
